info.name: Amaze Fab & Amaze Ops — Customer App Integration API
info.description: Production & Staging APIs for connecting the Customer App with Amaze Ops Factory Network. Covers Services catalog sync, Order booking, QR tags, Wardrobe & QC image URLs, Live tracking, and Digital Garment Passports.

item.name: Push Services to Amaze Ops (Customer App -> Amaze Ops)

request.description: Customer App pushes its services. Amaze Ops saves them and preserves configured Gold/Yellow/Blue partner payout rates.
Fetches active services with configured Gold, Yellow, and Blue pricing.
Places customer order into factory queue with QR tags and initial wardrobe photos.

item.name: Live Order Tracking by Order ID

request.description: Returns current order milestone, per-garment processing status, and QC inspection photos.
Customer App notifies that logistics has been scheduled. Displays PICKUP ARRANGED badge across Admin and Partner Apps.
Partner or Admin confirms that the logistics rider has picked up the garments. Final stage for Amaze Ops.
Fetches order history for customer mobile number.

item.name: Get Garment Lifetime Passport & QC Archive

request.description: Retrieves complete lifetime history for a garment's physical QR tag.
